# Lenovo ThinkPad P14s Gen 7 (AMD) — 14" Mobile Workstation

**Category:** Laptop (Mobile Workstation)

## Tech Specs

| Spec | Detail |
|---|---|
| Processor | AMD Ryzen AI PRO 400 series (Gorgon Point): Ryzen AI 5 PRO 440 (6C/12T, 2.0–4.8GHz), Ryzen AI 7 PRO 450 (8C/16T, 2.0–5.1GHz), or Ryzen AI 9 HX PRO 470 (12C/24T, 2.0–5.2GHz) |
| Graphics | Integrated AMD Radeon 840M / 860M / 890M (matched to CPU tier); no discrete GPU option |
| NPU | Integrated AMD Ryzen AI, up to 55 TOPS (up to 86 TOPS platform total on HX PRO 470); Copilot+ PC certified |
| Display | 14" 16:10; options include WUXGA (1920x1200) IPS 400/500nit up to 1500:1 contrast, or 2.8K (2880x1800) OLED 500nit, 100% DCI-P3, 30–120Hz VRR, DisplayHDR True Black 500, Dolby Vision |
| Memory | Up to 96GB DDR5-5600 non-ECC, 2x SODIMM slots, dual-channel |
| Storage | One M.2 2280 slot; PCIe 4.0 x4 (256GB/512GB/1TB) or PCIe 5.0 x4 Performance (2TB), Opal 2.0 |
| Battery | 60Wh or 75Wh Li-ion, Rapid Charge (80% in 1hr); 75Wh pairs with 100W adapter |
| Ports | 2x USB-A 5Gbps (1 Always On), 2x Thunderbolt 4 (USB PD 3.0), 1x HDMI 2.1 (4K/60Hz), 3.5mm combo audio jack, 1x GbE RJ-45, Kensington Nano slot; optional Nano-SIM slot and smart card reader |
| Wireless | MediaTek Wi-Fi 7 MT7925 (802.11be 2x2) + Bluetooth 5.4; optional Snapdragon X61 5G Sub-6 WWAN with eSIM |
| Ethernet | Gigabit Ethernet, Realtek RTL8111EPV, Wake-on-LAN, AMD PRO Manageability |
| Security | Firmware or discrete TPM 2.0, optional fingerprint reader (match-on-chip), optional IR camera for Windows Hello, optional smart card reader, self-healing BIOS, bottom cover tamper detection |
| Camera | 5.0MP (+IR on select models) with privacy shutter; top-tier option adds HDR and Computer Vision human presence detection |
| Audio | Realtek ALC3287 HD codec, stereo 2W x2 speakers with Dolby Atmos, dual-mic far-field array with Dolby Voice |
| Keyboard | 6-row spill-resistant, multimedia Fn keys, Copilot key, optional LED backlight; 3-button TrackPoint + Mylar multi-touch TrackPad (60x115mm) |
| Dimensions | 313.6 x 221.7 x 12.06–22.6mm (12.35 x 8.73 x 0.47–0.89in), depending on panel |
| Weight | Starting at 1.29 kg (2.84 lbs) |
| OS Support | Windows 11 Pro/Home, Fedora Linux, Ubuntu Linux, Red Hat Enterprise Linux 10.2 (certified) |
| Certifications | MIL-STD-810H tested, ENERGY STAR 9.0, EPEAT Gold, TCO Certified Gen 10, RoHS compliant |

## Notable Features

- Shares its chassis with the ThinkPad T14 Gen 7, gaining improved repairability and a more modular design versus prior P14s generations
- Only new P-series model launched exclusively with integrated AMD Radeon graphics — no discrete Nvidia GPU option, keeping it Lenovo's lightest mobile workstation
- Higher-TDP AMD platform (30W) and larger 75Wh battery option versus predecessor
- Up to 96GB of user-replaceable DDR5-5600 RAM and up to 2TB of PCIe Gen 5 storage
- Fedora Linux listed as an officially supported OS alongside Ubuntu and RHEL
- Optional 2.8K OLED panel with 120Hz VRR, Dolby Vision, and X-Rite factory color calibration
